text:
Since the comrade is dead,

All of us together die

a little.


The value of our tears

Over the one who lost his life

is nothing.


Love, in this sadness,

Is a sigh in a forest,

Is a good idea.


Out of straight fidelity

To the lost comrade,

What remains to us?


To let ourselves die a little

For the one whom today we see

Wholly dead.

translation.title: Since the Comrade Is Dead...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the restrained communal mourning and fidelity to the dead comrade.
